curation.notes: Imported from validation panel. Original serotype: Enteritidis. Panel notes: Detected Sdf I that is characteristic of commonly circulating strains of serotype Enteritidis.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR1248786 && mv data/SRR1248786_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR1248786_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

SeqSero2.run_cmd: SeqSero2_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2/ -n seqsero2

SeqSero2S.run_cmd: SeqSero2S_package.py -m a -t 4 -i data/reads_1.fq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz -d actual/seqsero2s/ -n seqsero2s

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype: Enteritidis. Antigenic formula should match 9:g,m:-. Note: Sdf marker characteristic of Enteritidis may be referenced by tool.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST11. Accept exact match. ST11 is dominant for Enteritidis. Flag novel alleles for manual review.

notes: Part of FDA-CFSAN validation panel. Detected Sdf I that is characteristic of commonly circulating strains of serotype Enteritidis.
